items.title: Frank Alkyer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Orleans, Louisiana, January 10, 2020
items.q: if I could sit down a day with Thelonious, if I could spend a day with Thelonious Monk I would have loved to spend a day with Thelonious Monk.

ctx.x: I remember that too and I’d go to the record store and you’re flipping through and sometimes it was the cover, but then you flip that thing over and sometimes you even learned about the reviewers and you learned well I like this reviewer, if he likes this record I’ll buy it.

Right. That’s exactly right, yeah. And that’s just it. You know at DownBeat we’re a little bit — we’re geeky. We just are. It’s like you look at our record reviews. There’s a star rating; there’s a review; and at the end of the review there’s a track listing with, there’s a tie; the album number, it’s like the code for the album in the catalogue; all the songs; how long this is, it’s 46 minutes, is it 53 minutes, whatever it is; a listing of all the players that are in that band. And that’s what makes our reviews…
Have you started down the path of reviewing musical releases that are not a physical product?
